case.title: windows: read-only diagnostic — Elenca i servizi attualmente attivi/in esecuzion
case.goal: Elenca i servizi attualmente attivi/in esecuzione in services.txt

reasoning: This is a pure OBSERVE task — no system change is warranted.
Write the collected facts verbatim to `services.txt`.
possible_mistakes: Modify state during a read-only task.
Report a hardcoded/guessed value instead of the observed one.
expected.success_criteria: `services.txt` exists and contains the correct, current values for the requested facts.
expected.recovery_strategy: No state changed; nothing to recover.

executed_commands: Write-Host @(@) -join @($_ | Where-Object { $_.Status -eq 'Running' } | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name) | Out-File -FilePath services.txt
$services = Get-Service | Where-Object { $_.Status -eq 'Running' } | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name; $services -join `n | Out-File -FilePath services.txt -Encoding UTF8
